name: Creative Corner Art Studio – Summer Art Club
description_short: Weekly summer art clubs for ages 5-11 at Creative Corner Art Studio in downtown Franklin, MA. Each week has a theme, with painting, pottery and clay, mixed media, jewelry and LEGO builds; a two-week session in July makes a short film with Franklin High School students. Half day 8:30-12:00 or full day 8:30-3:30, with a Friday art share for families.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds on studio events, services or products. You can get a credit instead, good for up to one year from purchase, toward any studio event, class or studio-branded merchandise. This does not cover artwork by local or third-party artists.

sources.note: Studio homepage: address, email, no-refund/credit policy.

Summer Art Club page: 'Creative Kid Art Summer Clubs, Summer 2026, Ages 5-11'; half day $300/week, full day $400/week; extended care 8:00-8:30 and 3:30-4:00 for $50/week; 'Lunch provided from home'; 2026 weeks and booking prices ('From $300', two-week session 'From $600'). Page header: 'Summer 2027 Programming Coming in January'.

warnings: This is the studio's homepage, not the Summer Art Club page. Summer Art Club shows up only as a menu item, with no details.

The page shows Fall 2026 studio hours. No 2027 summer information is given, so season_year was left blank.
The footer copyright says 2022, so some page content may be old.
